verdict.rationale: API versioning and a documented deprecation policy are a fair question for a fintech platform that offers programmatic APIs and SDKs, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versions, version pinning, changelogs, or a deprecation or sunset policy. The cited items cover only general API capabilities (accounts, payouts, SDKs, webhooks, sandbox), which do not show versioning or deprecation guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
